verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents the App API for fetching data, with a published OpenAPI spec. Its CLI wraps the Journeys API and returns structured JSON. The MCP server and AI can read workspace data and report on how messages perform. Together these suggest performance data is reachable programmatically, but no evidence explicitly names campaign or flow metrics endpoints, and nothing shows export into a warehouse or dashboard. missing for 10: explicit documentation of campaign/broadcast/workflow metrics endpoints, metric granularity and fields, documented warehouse or BI export of performance data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
